_comment: IndentSize is disabled because it is incompatible with the output of this project's own formatters.
Both rustfmt and prettier use alignment as well as indentation, and an aligned continuation line is not a multiple of the indent size by definition.
rustfmt indents a wrapped string literal to sit under the opening quote; prettier indents a numbered list continuation by three spaces to sit under '1. '.
Measured: with this check on, the repository reports 23 errors and every one of them is formatter output, not a mistake.
What remains is still worth running: end-of-line, final newline and trailing whitespace on LICENSE, TOML files and dotfiles, which no formatter in the gate can even parse.

No tree is excluded. `.specify/` was skipped while spec-kit owned it and rewrote it with CRLF on every `specify update`, which `git add` then refused; the CLI that wrote those files is gone, and the one file left in that directory is written by hand like every other.
